insights: Dark-to-light theme transitions create dramatic narrative rhythm, with product sections in light neutrals contrasting against security/trust sections in deep navy/purple.
Generous whitespace and centered layouts emphasize premium positioning—large typography scales (arcadia-display, tiempos-heading) with ample padding (gap-2xl: 72px, layout-padding-xl: 128px).
Grid system scales from mobile (1 col) to desktop (16 cols) with consistent 32px gutters, ensuring compositional integrity across breakpoints while maintaining generous spacing.
Product imagery (dark UI mockups, 3D renders) uses high contrast against light backgrounds; lifestyle/landscape photography adds emotional warmth between technical sections.
Rounded corners (border-radius: 0.75rem to 2rem) and subtle shadows unify card-based components, while pill-shaped buttons (rounded-5xl) reinforce the modern, approachable brand aesthetic.
